newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's CIOR cement firm raises profits in 96.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's CIOR cement firm raises profits in 96.

text.p: Morocco's second largest cement company, les Ciments de l'Oriental net profits increased four-fold to 86.5 million dirhams ($9.3 million) from 21.6 million dirhams the previous year.
A spokesman on Monday attributed the firm's good results to the drop in production costs and increase of sales in 1996 to 1.44 million tonnes but he gave no comparative figure for 1995.
CIOR, in which Switzerland's Holderbank has 51 percent stake, registered a turnover of 905 million dirhams in 1996 from 842 million dirhams the previous year.
It was last traded on March 28, at 658 dirhams.
